:::{#sol-residual-variance-more-covariates}

Fix a [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$.
The [law of total variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-total-variance) holds for every [random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) with a finite second moment,
so it holds [conditional on](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-expectation) $\Predvar = \predvar$.
With $Z$ in the role of the conditioning variable, it gives

$$
\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar = \predvar}
= \E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar = \predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar = \predvar}
+ \Var{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar = \predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar = \predvar}.
$$

The equation holds at every $\predvar$,
so it holds with the random $\Predvar$ in place of $\predvar$.
Take the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of both sides over $\Predvar$:

$$
\ba
\E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}
&= \E{\E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar} + \Var{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(the identity above, with } \Predvar \text{ in place of } \predvar \text{)} \\
&= \E{\E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar}} + \E{\Var{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)} \\
&= \E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z}} + \E{\Var{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar, Z} \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(law of iterated expectations)}
\ea
$$

:::
